I'm running the skill's contrast script on every colour pair, then writing up the polish. ## UI polish: Invoice card 17 fixes across Spacing, Typography, Contrast, Hierarchy, States, Layout, Motion and Tokens. Text and brand hue kept. Tokens from tokens.css. ### Fixes 1. **Spacing**: `.card` `padding: 13px` is off the scale. Now `padding: var(--space-12)`. (R-ui-polish-1, R-ui-polish-20) 2. **Spacing**: `h2` `margin: 0 0 5px` is off the scale. Now `margin: 0 0 var(--space-4)`. (R-ui-polish-1, R-ui-polish-20) 3. **Spacing**: button `padding: 6px 10px` is off the scale. Now `padding: var(--space-8) var(--space-12)`. (R-ui-polish-1, R-ui-polish-20) 4. **Spacing**: the two buttons had only a whitespace gap between them. Now `margin-left: var(--space-8)` on the second button. (R-ui-polish-1, R-ui-polish-20) 5. **Typography**: `h2` `font-size: 22px` is off the scale. Now `font-size: var(--font-size-2xl)` with `line-height: var(--line-height-heading)`. (R-ui-polish-2, R-ui-polish-3, R-ui-polish-20) 6. **Typography**: body `p` `font-size: 13px` is below 16 px. Now `font-size: var(--font-size-md)`. (R-ui-polish-2, R-ui-polish-20) 7. **Typography**: `p` had no line-height or measure. Now `line-height: var(--line-height-body); max-width: var(--measure)`. (R-ui-polish-3, R-ui-polish-20) 8. **Typography**: buttons used the browser's default font size (13.33 px) and font. Now `font-family: inherit; font-size: var(--font-size-md)`. (R-ui-polish-2, R-ui-polish-20) 9. **Contrast**: `p` `#999999` on `#ffffff` is 2.85:1. Now `var(--color-text-muted)` (#4a6462), 6.38:1. (R-ui-polish-4, R-ui-polish-20) 10. **Hierarchy**: "Download PDF" was a second filled button. Now a secondary outline: transparent background, `var(--color-action-secondary-text)` text, `var(--border-width-hairline) solid var(--color-action-secondary-border)` border, 5.47:1. (R-ui-polish-5, R-ui-polish-20) 11. **States**: the buttons had no hover style. "Pay now" now darkens to `#1d4ed8`, and "Download PDF" now gets `var(--color-selected-bg)` on hover. (R-ui-polish-6) 12. **States**: the buttons had no focus style. Now `:focus-visible { outline: var(--border-width-focus) solid var(--color-border-focus); outline-offset: 2px }`. (R-ui-polish-6, R-ui-polish-20) 13. **States**: the buttons had no disabled style. Now `:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed }`, and hover does not apply when a button is disabled. (R-ui-polish-6) 14. **Layout**: the buttons were about 29 px tall. Now `min-height: var(--size-target-min); min-width: var(--size-target-min)`. (R-ui-polish-7, R-ui-polish-20) 15. **Motion**: `transition: box-shadow .3s` had no reduced-motion handling and no token. Now `var(--duration-slow) var(--ease-standard)`, and it is turned off under `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce`. (R-ui-polish-9, R-ui-polish-20) 16. **Tokens**: these colours already matched token values, so they are now written as tokens. `#ffffff` card background is `var(--color-surface-default)`, `#202d2c` heading is `var(--color-text-default)`, and `#fff` button text is `var(--color-action-primary-text)`. (R-ui-polish-20) 17. **Tokens**: `font-family: system-ui` is now `var(--font-family-sans)`. `border-radius: 5px` (not on the radius scale) is now `var(--radius-md)` on the card and `var(--radius-control)` on the buttons. Border width `1px` is now `var(--border-width-hairline)`.
